en-US.name: Flow Bookings
en-US.summary: Book and pay at local salons, barbers and spas by voice, settled with PayPal.
en-US.description: Flow Bookings is the voice side of Flow, an AI booking agent for small businesses. Say what you would like (a haircut, a massage this weekend) and Flow finds a time, books it and pays with your saved PayPal within the spending limit you set. Ask what are my bookings to hear them. Link the skill once with the 4-digit code on the Alexa page of your Flow demo, and say disconnect my account to unlink. PayPal sandbox only: fake money.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask flow bookings to book me a haircut
Alexa, ask flow bookings to disconnect my account
